entity_agreement.automatic_labels: auto_label column (matcher output stored in the sheet)
entity_agreement.sample_design: stratified by model x automatic label (25 per cell); NOT representative of the dataset

original_labels.note: Agreement on a sample stratified by model x automatic label; not representative of the dataset and not a population estimate of label accuracy.

flagged_rows.reason: Target entity 'surgery' is lexically present; the hypothesis reverses its context (without surgery -> with surgery). Original label not_preserved is kept unchanged. Under the lexical Layer 1 definition the alternative is 'preserved'; the negation error belongs to Layer 2 (flagged there as a negation candidate).
'AP radiograph' (image) vs 'AP radiography' (procedure). Clinical equivalence is not established; original label kept, flagged for expert review.

sensitivity_excluding_flagged.note: Agreement on a sample stratified by model x automatic label; not representative of the dataset and not a population estimate of label accuracy.

sensitivity_with_alternative_labels.note: Agreement on a sample stratified by model x automatic label; not representative of the dataset and not a population estimate of label accuracy.

automatic_labels_recomputed_v3.note: Agreement on a sample stratified by model x automatic label; not representative of the dataset and not a population estimate of label accuracy.

layer2_annotations.interpretation: Text-only discrepancy annotations on a priority/stratified review sample. Span-level rate = share of flagged spans judged a meaningful discrepancy (heuristic precision on this sample only). Context-level labels are case-study judgements: not detector precision, not error prevalence, and not clinical significance.
